topics.title: Getting around
topics.blurb: The server panel has the welcome, the current season, the wipe countdown and your mail.

Pick easy, medium, hard, elite, expert or nightmare. Harder pays more RP. You can change once every 24 hours. In a fight, whoever hits first sets the level for everyone who joins: damage both ways, and the most the kill pays.

topics.title: Seasons and tokens
topics.blurb: Each season has its own token and its own command: /ecto for Halloween, /ega for the Marine Corps Birthday, and so on. The examples use /ecto; swap in the season's command. The Season tab in /info shows the current one.
cmds: Your tokens, whether you're in costume, the community meter
This season's title, like [Pumpkin King '26]. Yours for life, survives wipes, and only sold while the season is on. Wear it from /chat.
Give tokens to the community meter. When it fills, something big happens (Halloween: the Headless Horseman rides).
Your one free costume this season
Marine Corps Birthday: your Eagle, Globe & Anchor. Earned in combat, kept for life, and its shop is open all year.

topics.title: Each season's command
topics.blurb: Use these the same way as /ecto above (shop, buy, offer...). Only the season that's on, or whose shop is still open, answers.
cmds: Easter week, ending Easter Sunday: Chipped Eggs
Memorial Day week, ending on the last Monday of May: Memorial Plaques
Labor Day week, ending on the first Monday of September: Hard Hats & Hammers
Talk Like a Pirate Day (Sep 17 – 21): Doubloons
Día de los Muertos (Nov 1 – 2): Sugar Skulls
Marine Corps Birthday (Nov 3 – 10): Eagle, Globe & Anchor, kept for life
Hanukkah (eight nights, dates move each year): Hanukkah Gelt. See the Hanukkah page.

topics.title: Grimwood Mutual
topics.blurb: Funeral insurance from the Undertaker of Grimwood Hollow. Pay a premium in scrap; die of a covered cause and the policy pays when you respawn. Read the fine print. Seriously, read it.

topics.title: Vehicle shop
topics.blurb: Buy cars, copters, trucks, karts and stranger things (a flying broom, a rocket chair...). When you buy one (or pick one up), it goes into your inventory as an item that may look like a box, or even a coffin: that's your vehicle. Place it like a box, or use Spawn in My Vehicles. A banner at the top of the screen tells you what happened every time.
cmds: Open the vehicle shop (/mvm and /vehicle work too)
Bring out a vehicle you own
Call your vehicle back to you
Stand near it to pack it back into your inventory (empty it first)

topics.title: Pirates
topics.blurb: A pirate ship sails the Deep Sea now and then, with a crew, cannons and a captain's chest.
cmds: Where the ship is, how far and which way, crew left and time left; or when the next sighting is due

topics.title: Trucker Event
topics.blurb: Now and then trailers appear at a monument with a drop zone and a timer. You need a Semi Truck to tow them: buy one in the vehicle shop (/vb). Drive up to a trailer to hook it, haul it into the drop zone with someone at the wheel, and earn trucker points and XP. Lose the trailer and you lose XP.
cmds: The vehicle shop: buy your Semi Truck here
Trucker leaderboard, your rank and stats, and the points store

topics.title: Server portals
topics.blurb: Portals that carry you, and your gear, to other servers.
cmds: Your last transfer code, if something went wrong. Give it to an admin.
How long you wait on a portal pad: 5, 10, 15 (recommended) or 30 seconds. Change it once every 24 hours. Stepping off the pad or getting hurt cancels the trip.

topics.title: Raidable Bases
topics.blurb: Raidable Bases are on our OTHER server, not this one. Take the portal to get there (/portals shows it), and take your gear with you. It's still PvE: you raid the bases, not other players. Raid difficulty (Easy to Nightmare) is how tough the BASE is; your /difficulty level is separate and is about you. Vehicles can't be driven into a raid.
cmds: Find the portal to the raid server
On the raid server: your raid stats and the leaderboard
On the raid server: buy a raid of your own (locked to you and your friends)

topics.title: Custom weapons
topics.blurb: No commands needed. Hold one and fire. Every rocket uses a rocket from your inventory.
cmds: Fires rockets. Double damage against helicopters.
Mortar: a lead rocket, then a six-rocket barrage. Needs 7 rockets.
Catapult: boulders plus up to four C4 from your inventory
Catapult: throws a cow. The cow explodes when it lands. No refunds.
Bolt-action rifle: every shot also sends a C4 from your inventory that sticks and blows. 8 seconds between C4 shots
Eoka: one rocket, then it breaks
